title: Sunken CIT
description: A CIT resource pack version of the Sunken and Withered Nautilus, from Mogswamp's 2026 April Fools Day video!
body:
## Sunken CIT

![The Sunken Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/22b3cac9b2e76ad417581ce18139e1f49adaafaf.png)

Rename a Zombie Nautilus to get the Withered Nautilus, or a Bogged to get the Sunken!  

This is a completely client-side pack, so you can add it to any existing world.

To get the full mod with transformations and gameplay mechanics, click here: https://modrinth.com/datapack/sunken/

Check out the short featuring this project here: https://www.youtube.com/shorts/5uBPFT-ecyA
